title: Nested include! slice C, conversion: 16 fragments of src/persist.rs become child modules, by the tool
outcome: 16 of the 19 files that src/persist.rs includes at its top level become child modules of persist.rs, converted by scripts/include-to-mod.mjs: `#[path]` + `mod` in persist.rs, one glob to hand the names on, `use super::*;` in the child, and `pub(super)` on what persist.rs or another file uses. Follows the formatting-only candidate of the same slice (sibling item w-2422bd1d69b0). Module paths change for the items of the converted files, so the tests they hold gain the module's name as one libtest path segment: by a count of the test attributes on master fa953922, 60 in the six persist_sqlite_*_tests.rs units and 26 in the three test modules two units declare (tests/native_test_completion_reader_floor.rs 8, its child tests/direct_prompt_reader_floor.rs 11, tests/test_request_custody_reader_floor.rs 7), 86 on Linux and 84 on Windows (two are cfg(unix)); the list check gives the exact names. Not in this slice: persist_metadata_units_codec.rs (a later small tool slice once persist_metadata_units.rs is a module), persist_direct_prompt.rs and persist_metadata_tracking.rs (hand-written reviewed candidates later), the two federation test units, the 12 inline blocks held out of slice A, and the comment follow-up. The units are listed in a note on this item.
acceptance: On the candidate, none of the listed include!() lines remains; each listed unit is mounted in its parent by a `mod` item, with `#[path]` where the file is not at the module's default location; and `node scripts/include-to-mod.mjs verify BASE CANDIDATE` reports no problem, where BASE is the candidate without this item's contribution.

The test names printed by `cargo test --bin termal -- --list` on the candidate differ from those of the candidate without this item's contribution only in the listed tests, each of which gains its new module's name as one path segment; the old and new names are recorded on the item.

Nothing in the repository refers to an old name of a listed test or to a module path that the conversion changes (scripts, docs, termal-tests.toml, the launcher's filters), or each such reference is updated in the candidate; the search and its result are recorded on the item, including every use of module_path!() and type_name that can reach an item of a converted unit.

`cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes on the candidate, and on Linux and on Windows the candidate's build has no warning that the candidate without this item's contribution lacks, or each such warning is recorded with its cause.
The coordinator's four patterns were checked on the listed units on the candidate's base and none occurs; the check is recorded on the item.
No test reads or pins source text for this change.

completion.summary: Landed: master fast-forwarded fbc6fd0c -> af85a417 by Opus2 (06:33:23Z), installed 06:42:49Z (sha256 B12FC11D…). 16 fragments of src/persist.rs are child modules, by scripts/include-to-mod.mjs; review pair clean (adopted from cf81f171 by identical contribution), Linux and Windows full gates passed on the exact commit, warning identity equal to the own parent on both platforms, evaluation 2 passed 6/6 (delegation-5cbf85e4).
